description: This file contains F# unit tests for Orleans' serialization support of various F# data types, including discriminated unions, records, recursive data structures, and other core F# types. It uses the Xunit testing framework to verify serialization integrity via round-trip testing and deep copying.

classes.name: FSharpSerializationTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods to verify serialization support for F# types in Orleans.

methods.name: Serialization_Roundtrip_FSharp_Unit
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the F# unit type.

methods.description: Verifies serialization support for enum-style discriminated unions without data.

methods.name: Serialization_Roundtrip_FSharp_RecursiveDU

methods.name: Serialization_Roundtrip_FSharp_GenericDU
